_about: Checked-in pass/fail example outputs for manifest cases whose deterministic oracles decide the result. scripts/check_assertion_examples.py grades every example with the pinned harness's own assertion evaluator: each pass example must satisfy every gate/critical objective assertion of each listed case, and each fail example must fail at least one. Judge assertions are not graded here.

groups.name: earned antithesis must be kept (over-application probe)
decorative antithesis must still be revised (control)
